deployments_detail.use: "Intelaw" — legal chatbot (billed first in Morocco) plus multidisciplinary simulators, on the bank's own site

CIH M3AK: WhatsApp virtual banking assistant ('assistance virtuelle') letting customers retrieve balance, account number, nearest ATM, credit status, transaction history, exchange/JAWAZ balance and bill info via conversational messaging [none named (WhatsApp channel)]

Intelaw legal/regulatory information platform for professional and business clients featuring a legal chatbot (billed as the first legal chatbot in Morocco) plus keyword search returning answers backed by legal texts [none named (internal)]
Strategic partnership deploying Microsoft 365 Copilot to internal teams as an AI productivity assistant to simplify daily tasks, boost productivity, and free staff for higher-value work [Microsoft]

Copilot Studio custom generative-AI and 'Agentic' assistants rolled out to employees, driven by an internal IA Adoption Office (change management + acculturation to GenAI); Copilot M365 and Copilot Studio named as the operational stack [Microsoft]

IA Factory: internal AI unit designing, industrializing and maintaining production AI solutions for prioritized business use cases, spanning ML/Deep Learning and generative AI/LLMs (prompting, RAG, agents) with MLOps/LLMOps pipelines [none named (internal; Python/LLM/RAG/agents stack)]

AI innovation Lab ('Lab d'innovation IA de CIH BANK') where students and startups co-incubate concrete AI/tech projects on the bank's priority themes, established via GITEX Africa 2025 university partnerships [none named (partners UIR, UM6P)]

Selection of Backbase 'AI-native' Engagement Banking platform to modernize digital banking (AI-powered personalization, streamlined onboarding for local and diaspora customers); AI feature scope not detailed by CIH [Backbase]
AI Bootcamp: hands-on workshops and masterclasses (with the EBRD) to equip and drive AI adoption among clients in tourism, logistics and e-commerce sectors [none named (partner EBRD)]
